plain: A researcher on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2026 describes the 1976 Tehran incident, when, as the story goes, jets of the Shah's Iranian air force chased a UFO over the city. He says two aerospace researchers, Lee Graham and Ron Regehr, claimed to have looked at printouts from the Defense Support Program, US satellites that watch for heat from missile launches, and found something unusual in infrared at the very day and time of the chase; the filmmaker James Fox is also named. If true, a US satellite would have backed up what the pilots reported.
